text_blocks.snippet: Essential tremor (ET) is characterized by rhythmic shaking, primarily in the hands, but also affecting the head, voice, and occasionally the legs. This tremor is most noticeable during voluntary movements, such as reaching for a glass or writing. While not life-threatening, ET can significantly impact daily life and activities.

list.snippet: Action Tremor: Shaking that occurs during voluntary movements.
Hand Tremor: Most commonly affects the hands, but can also involve the forearms.
Head Tremor: Shaking of the head, sometimes described as a "yes-yes" or "no-no" motion.
